sources.title: AfriVox-v2: A Domain-Verticalized Benchmark for In-the-Wild African ...
sources.snippet: Finally, we benchmark a new generation of speech models, including Sahara-v2, Gemini 3 Flash, and the Omnilingual CTC models. Our results expose the true generalization gap of modern speech models in specialized, noisy African contexts and provide a reliable blueprint for developers building localized voice AI.
